name: Qwen3-30B-A3B
summary: Pre-hybrid MoE baseline. Shows what the Gated DeltaNet hybrid architecture bought versus the Wave-1 MoEs at the same active-parameter count.
notes: No MTP head, so speculative decoding is off.

practical_baseline.rationale: The only reported stable 4-bit-or-better lane, with a reproducible MLX server recipe and single-stream decode measurement.
